reviews.note: At 13 January 2026 this predates the current first mention of 6 May 2026. Five lineages, all different, all here.
At 13 January 2026 this predates the current first mention of 16 January 2026. Names two of the small books by title and says he and his wife use them daily in the car.

The strongest self-check in the corpus so far: he names the country, tells the audience what would count as failure, and tells them to stop watching him if it comes. He adds that he could have missed it even believing the Lord told him to do this.
Red all around Taiwan described as acid rain and a red dawn, with Australia looking on. He does not say what the red is, so nothing here can be scored until it is named.
The Mexico half of the claim: joining the dollar with the peso retired, framed as a business decision about the economy.

At 13 January 2026 this predates both the current first mention of 15 April 2026 and the earliest live row of 4 March 2026. Adds stability across South America and Mexico, and the Portuguese alongside the Spanish.
Mainly Israel with America backing, on the pattern of the June 2025 operation but bigger. Naming a real prior operation as the template makes the comparison checkable.

Set in stone, already happened, already in motion, they are next, taken quickly. No prayer clause and no condition, which is rare enough in this corpus to be worth flagging: he has removed his own escape.
Adds the Israeli law of return as the mechanism, prompted by his co-host rather than volunteered. Not scored as the first mention: another live row in this same video at 143 seconds is earlier.
At 13 January 2026 this predates the current first mention of 15 January 2026. Adds people building houses in Gaza alongside the statement about the land.
Repeats it and marks it as what the Lord just said rather than his own view, adding that it is not politically correct.
At 13 January 2026 this predates the current first mention of 20 January 2026, and the video is titled for it. Names the three decisions: Gaza, Israel and Iran.

A different limit from the usual one: not that he misreads timing but that his language cannot carry the detail. Recorded because it is also a standing reason any missing specific can be explained away.
A description of the experience of the vision with no content attached to any of the places named.
Liberation for the people and a major revival, given as the thing prayer is required for.
The Stargate comparison again. He says outright he does not know whether it is now or further in the future, which leaves the claim with no window.
Adds a blast zone of fifty miles or more that vaporised things. Worth recording that he corrects his own first reading: he assumed tactical nuclear weapons and says he was told no.
Ground rather than aerial drones so that soldiers are not sent out. Chinese ground combat robots are an active public programme, so the base rate here is not low.
Adds fifty calibre guns on tracks. The confirmation offered is an image pulled up on the programme matching the shield he described, which is not an event.
Adds people entering codes to open the portals and talking to spirits through them. Nothing in this can be checked.
Gold at all-time highs prompting old dormant mines in Colorado, Utah and California to be reopened. Named states and a named commodity make this one of the more checkable claims in the batch.
Adds panning creek beds in Colorado and the expectation that a small find would be worth a substantial amount.
Adds that he heard the exact phrase new gold rush in the headlines, worldwide and especially in America. A headline phrase is directly checkable, which most of this batch is not.
He says twice that he does not know what the number is and only guesses at a rate, which is a refusal to interpret rather than a claim.

At 10 January 2026 this predates the current first mention of 13 April 2026 and the earliest live row of 24 January 2026. The V of Arab men behind the Saudi crown prince going into Israel to negotiate over Gaza.
At 10 January 2026 this predates the current first mention of 24 January 2026. He says the ninth hole is a type and a shadow and a code, and that he does not read codes.
Adds the flag detail: Gaza in blue and white cursive with blue outlining like an Israeli flag.

Oil and gas under the soil and under the Mediterranean off the coast, with the Saudi crown prince arriving with it. The Gaza Marine field has been public for two decades, so the existence of the gas is not itself a hit.
Adds that he prays it is before the rapture, and repeats that he has seen part and heard part.
Adds the luxury district: Ferraris, Mercedes and something like Monaco, worked out with his co-host on air.
Five pots over America, a blessing in each and a warning attached to each. The warnings are not given here.
Adds a western covered wagon or stagecoach in one of the pots, which he ties elsewhere to the Sooners crypto material.
Puts the vision in front of a named bank and brings in the named asset manager's founder, which is more content than the standing warning usually carries.
Adds a Canada and New York connection and darkness around the man. The identification is made from a picture put in front of him on air rather than named first, which weakens it.

Acceleration of time and of money, with the Lord saying his people must move faster. Not scored as the first mention despite being the earliest such row, because the September 2026 dating that defines the claim is absent here.
Picketing at Gaza and in America over the land not being returned. The Satan's will house material at the start of the passage belongs with blackrock-warning.
Adds the resort as the trigger and puts Greenland anger alongside it in the same breath.

Names the French president as loudest with England, Germany and Italy behind him, which is the European rift the claim already carries. Not scored as the first mention: this is the reaction rather than the instruction.
Gives a motive for the speed of the moves: the dollar in trouble and an economy worse than stated. He recalls the dam himself.
Adds barbed wire around everything and names Chicago, New York and Philadelphia with nobody on the streets.
At 10 January 2026 this predates the current first mention of 13 January 2026. Adds that it happens by a vote, not all at once, and because the economy is in trouble.
Adds the two hearts joining in Japan and ties the covered wagon in the pot to the Sooners, with the Japanese and South Korean economies joining.
Adds the lifeline of military equipment and his own assessment that this is already happening rather than future.
He raises the objection himself, that Russia is stretched in Ukraine, and answers it with there are not very many, which is a tighter and more falsifiable form than the usual.
Adds the turf war framing and brings Cuba into it as devising a plan.
Stated as present fact rather than as forecast: American people on the ground right now taking out key targets. That makes it checkable against the record for January 2026 rather than open-ended.
At 10 January 2026 this predates the current first mention of 13 January 2026. Puts the ten thousand coming through Brazil into Venezuela, presenting themselves as peacemakers.
Adds that they are mostly Cuban rather than Russian, with only a couple of trained combat men, and that Cuba knows the territory.
Adds the white t-shirts and blue jeans, and his own answer that the effect is only to raise tension.
That cocaine moves from South America through Europe, Canada and Asia is long-established fact rather than forecast, so this is recorded but carries no predictive weight.
Reverses the direction: here Cuba asks Russia for help rather than helping Russia, in a clash of two fronts involving America.
A specific and checkable image: the Cuban leader underground in the side of a cliff with a light on, soldiers around him and a blue shirt.

At 10 January 2026 this predates the current first mention of 13 January 2026. Military moved through Brazil into Venezuela for jungle warfare against American troops. He calls it a very detailed vision.
Adds the factories with what look like slave labourers outside, placed around Venezuela, Cuba and Colombia, and Cuba protecting the assets.
Adds the drug lords paying Cuba to protect them because they know America is coming.
